# From Vila Tamarin to Plateau Square

The first President to have grown up on the slopes above Katanaí took office yesterday, and the slopes came down to watch. On the buses home people sang and argued about the speech. The Voice congratulates the President and reminds her of the oldest rule of the periphery: a promise made in public is paid in public. We have written hers down.
